newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end higher after Wall Street rise.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end higher after Wall Street rise.

text.p: The Jakarta stock index closed higher on Wednesday on a modest rebound in some blue chips coupled with active buying in secondaries, brokers said.
They said Tuesday's sharp rise in the Dow Jones average had prompted buying interest in some firstliners, particularly those at bargain levels, but the volume was small.

The composite index closed up 4.82 points, or 0.74 percent, at 652.05. Advancers led losers by 85 to 37 with 68 issues unchanged. Total turn-over was estimated at 385 billion rupiah compared to 652 billion rupiah on Tuesday.
An analyst with a Japanese brokerage said she expected the market to move in a narrow range on Thursday as many investors were looking for short-term gains.

"The index may continue to rise tomorrow but concern over domestic political situation ahead of the May 29 general election will see most counters moving in a narrow range or even edging down on profit-taking," she said.
Analysts and brokers said that although the current weak market offered a good opportunity for investors to accumulate stocks, they were likely be sidelined until after the polls.
Blue-chips such as telecommunications firm Telkom, cigarette maker Sampoerna and its rival Gudang Garam were among the target of buyers, brokers said.
Brokers said the market focus remained on small property firm Elang after reports that the Bakrie Group, which has a majority stake in company, planned to place its property projects under Elang.
Elang, the most actively traded counter with some 49.2 million shares changing hands, rose 225 rupiah to 1,650 rupiah.

Newly-listed Multidana was the second most active counter, rising 125 rupiah to 2,750 rupiah on market talk that the share price would touch the 2,800-rupiah level on Wednesday on continued strong demand, brokers said.
Shipping firm Berlian Laju Tanker was the top gainer of the day, rising 20 percent, or 300 rupiah, to close at 2,250 rupiah on a volume of 7.6 million shares.
"I heard the company had secured a new syndicated loan for business development," a broker with local firm said.
Company officials were not available for comment.
